name: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited

facts.business: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited operates in Performance Polymers & Chemicals, P&K Fertilizers, and Agri Nutrients segments.
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions include sale of goods to Jubilant Industries Inc. USA (Rs 570.37 million) and Jubilant Ingrevia Limited (Rs 142.55 million); purchase of goods from Jubilant Pharmova Limited (Rs 74.50 million), Jubilant Ingrevia Limited (Rs 273.82 million), and Jubilant Enpro (P) Limited (Rs 0.24 million); rent income and expenses with various group entities.
